name: Erik Svensson
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport catering wasn't exactly planned. After culinary school in Stockholm, he bounced around various restaurants, always seeking a faster-paced environment. A chance encounter with a former F3 driver at a local cafe led to an opportunity to join a small racing team, initially just handling meal prep. He quickly realized that his organizational skills and ability to handle pressure translated perfectly to the chaotic world of a racing paddock. 

Now at ART Grand Prix, Erik is responsible for ensuring the entire team is well-fed and energized throughout the race weekend. He prides himself on creating diverse and nutritious menus that cater to the specific dietary needs of the drivers and engineers. What sets Erik apart is his proactive approach; he's constantly researching new recipes and sourcing local ingredients, always striving to improve the team's performance through optimal nutrition. He believes a well-fed team is a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Erik is a relatively tall man, with a lean build that suggests an active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Has a habit of humming Swedish folk songs while preparing food.
Obsessively cleans his workstation before and after every meal service.
